title: Traditional Ukrainian Borscht
description: A hearty and flavorful beet-based soup originating from Ukraine. This recipe combines the sweetness of beets with the savory flavor of pork.
instructions: In a large pot, heat oil over medium heat.
Add diced onion and cook until translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add minced garlic and cook for an additional 1-2 minutes.
Add diced pork and cook until browned, about 5-7 minutes.
Add beets, carrots, and potatoes to the pot. Pour in beef broth and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low and simmer for 20-25 minutes or until vegetables are tender.
Stir in borscht and cook for an additional 5 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Garnish with chopped fresh dill before serving.
Serve hot, accompanied by a dollop of sour cream and a side of crusty bread.
